visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long, vibrant pink hair and a young girl with black hair stand in a brightly lit modern kitchen. The woman wears a navy and white t-shirt with a "Wendy's" logo, gesturing towards the camera as she speaks with an expressive facial expression. The background shows a stainless steel refrigerator with magnets, white cabinetry, and an oven. The lighting is bright and even. (2) A close-up shot focuses on a black LAICA brand sous-vide immersion circulator attached to a clear plastic container of water. Inside the water, a teal silicone bag containing marinated chicken pieces is visible. The machine has a digital display on top showing technical settings. No people are visible in this specific framing. (3) Returning to the medium shot, the pink-haired woman continues her explanation, gesturing with her right hand while the young girl stands beside her, looking at the camera with an amazed, wide-eyed expression. The kitchen setting remains consistent with the previous wide shot. (4) A top-down close-up shows hands pouring cooked, saucy chicken from a teal silicone bag onto a light blue ceramic plate. The plate already has a bed of orange-red sauce. The chicken appears tender and well-marinated with visible seasoning and steam. (5) The woman is now seated at a dining table, holding pink chopsticks. She picks up a piece of the chicken and takes a bite, showing an expression of satisfaction and nodding. On the table are other small dishes, including a salad, sliced tomatoes, and a glass of milk. (6) The young girl is also seated at the table, wearing a white t-shirt with a "Chikawa" graphic. She uses chopsticks to eat a piece of chicken, nodding and looking pleased with the taste. The living room and a television are visible in the blurred background.
